title: Local error estimates for a finite element method combining linear and nonlinear stabilization for the linear hyperbolic transport equation
summary: In this paper, we investigate the combination of a linear continuous interior penalty type and a non-linear artificial diffusion stabilisation applied to the transport problem, based on continuous Galerkin finite elements in space. This method was recently introduced and analysed for globally smooth solutions in [Burman 2023, SIAM J. Sci. Comput., 45, 1, A96-A122].
